prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. Her hand at the shoe draws the yellow card out of the window and carries it low over the felt, yellow side up, to its place well to the right of the middle of the picture, in front of the shoe, where the last frame shows it. There her thumb slides under the long edge nearest it and lifts it as her wrist turns thumb side up; the card rolls over on its opposite long edge, which stays on the felt, and her thumb comes over onto the blue face. Then her open hand glides back low over the felt, palm down, to the shoe and takes the next card. The other hand rests on the felt. Only one card moves; its back is yellow and its face is blue.
